textLabel.comment: Accessible name of the page's text box.

intro.comment: The text box's content while it is empty, ZenPen-style: the user deletes it and writes. Paragraphs (\n\n): what TaigiKeyboard is; desktop-only, switch to an English input method; how to start and what the sidebar holds; sponsorship; the maintainer's signature (Bîn-hiân, a name, never translated). Hanji authored by the maintainer 2026-11-09; tailo / poj / en / ja follow home.aboutIntro's wording and the existing keys for 快速齒, 選字窗, 色水, 贊助.

values.hanji:
台語齒盤是一个免費、開源 ê 台灣話拍字家私，拍字 ia̋n-jín 由台灣人家己開發，台語齒盤永遠免費、無廣告，嘛袂推出付費功能。毋管是一般使用者、學生、先生、學校抑是台語教育團體，攏會當自由使用。向望逐家寫台文、教台語 ê 時，免有額外 ê 負擔。

台語齒盤網頁版目前干焦支援電腦，使用進前，請先切去英語輸入法就會當開始拍台文，毋免安裝任何台語輸入法。

文字刪掉就會當開始使用，標題嘛會當改。倒手爿邊仔有設定頁面，毋管是台羅、白話字攏會當拍、嘛有辭典開關、快速齒、選字窗外觀、色水 ê 功能會當調整。

維持台語齒盤運作需要誠濟所費，若台語齒盤對你有幫助，歡迎贊助寄付，你 ê 支持予我力量繼續為著台語拍拚。

Bîn-hiân
values.tailo:
Tâi-gí Khí-puânn sī tsi̍t ê bián-huì, khai-guân ê Tâi-uân-uē phah-jī ke-si, phah-jī ia̋n-jín iû Tâi-uân-lâng ka-tī khai-huat, Tâi-gí Khí-puânn íng-uán bián-huì, bô kóng-kò, mā bē tshui-tshut hù-huì kong-lîng. M̄-kuán sī it-puann sú-iōng-tsiá, ha̍k-sing, sian-sinn, ha̍k-hāu ia̍h-sī Tâi-gí kàu-io̍k thuân-thé, lóng ē-tàng tsū-iû sú-iōng. Ǹg-bāng ta̍k-ke siá Tâi-bûn, kà Tâi-gí ê sî, bián ū gia̍h-guā ê hū-tam.

Tâi-gí Khí-puânn bāng-ia̍h-pán bo̍k-tsiân kan-na tsi-uān tiān-náu, sú-iōng tsìn-tsîng, tshiánn sing tshiat khì Ing-gí su-ji̍p-huat tō ē-tàng khai-sí phah Tâi-bûn, m̄-bián an-tsong jīm-hô Tâi-gí su-ji̍p-huat.

Bûn-jī san-tiāu tō ē-tàng khai-sí sú-iōng, piau-tê mā ē-tàng kái. Tò-tshiú-pîng pinn-á ū siat-tīng ia̍h-bīn, m̄-kuán sī Tâi-lô, Pe̍h-uē-jī lóng ē-tàng phah, mā ū sû-tián khui-kuan, khuài-sok khí, suán-jī-thang guā-kuan, sik-tsuí ê kong-lîng ē-tàng tiâu-tsíng.

Uî-tshî Tâi-gí Khí-puânn ūn-tsok su-iàu tsiânn tsē sóo-huì, nā Tâi-gí Khí-puânn tuì lí ū pang-tsōo, huan-gîng tsàn-tsōo kià-hù, lí ê tsi-tshî hōo guá li̍k-liōng kè-sio̍k uī-tio̍h Tâi-gí phah-piànn.

Bîn-hiân
values.poj:
Tâi-gí Khí-pôaⁿ sī chi̍t ê bián-hùi, khai-goân ê Tâi-oân-ōe phah-jī ke-si, phah-jī ia̋n-jín iû Tâi-oân-lâng ka-tī khai-hoat, Tâi-gí Khí-pôaⁿ éng-oán bián-hùi, bô kóng-kò, mā bē chhui-chhut hù-hùi kong-lêng. M̄-koán sī it-poaⁿ sú-iōng-chiá, ha̍k-seng, sian-siⁿ, ha̍k-hāu ia̍h-sī Tâi-gí kàu-io̍k thoân-thé, lóng ē-tàng chū-iû sú-iōng. Ǹg-bāng ta̍k-ke siá Tâi-bûn, kà Tâi-gí ê sî, bián ū gia̍h-gōa ê hū-tam.

Tâi-gí Khí-pôaⁿ bāng-ia̍h-pán bo̍k-chiân kan-na chi-oān tiān-náu, sú-iōng chìn-chêng, chhiáⁿ seng chhiat khì Eng-gí su-ji̍p-hoat tō ē-tàng khai-sí phah Tâi-bûn, m̄-bián an-chong jīm-hô Tâi-gí su-ji̍p-hoat.

Bûn-jī san-tiāu tō ē-tàng khai-sí sú-iōng, piau-tê mā ē-tàng kái. Tò-chhiú-pêng piⁿ-á ū siat-tēng ia̍h-bīn, m̄-koán sī Tâi-lô, Pe̍h-ōe-jī lóng ē-tàng phah, mā ū sû-tián khui-koan, khoài-sok khí, soán-jī-thang gōa-koan, sek-chúi ê kong-lêng ē-tàng tiâu-chéng.

Î-chhî Tâi-gí Khí-pôaⁿ ūn-chok su-iàu chiâⁿ chē só͘-hùi, nā Tâi-gí Khí-pôaⁿ tùi lí ū pang-chō͘, hoan-gêng chàn-chō͘ kià-hù, lí ê chi-chhî hō͘ góa le̍k-liōng kè-sio̍k ūi-tio̍h Tâi-gí phah-piàⁿ.

Bîn-hiân
values.en:
TaigiKeyboard is a free, open-source Taiwanese typing tool, its typing engine developed by Taiwanese people themselves. TaigiKeyboard is free forever, with no ads and no paid features ever. Everyday users, students, teachers, schools and Taiwanese-language education groups are all free to use it. The hope is that writing and teaching Taiwanese comes with no extra burden.

TaigiKeyboard for the web currently supports computers only. Switch to an English input method and you can start typing Taiwanese, with no Taiwanese input method to install.

Delete this text to begin; the title can be changed too. The settings are in the sidebar on the left: type in Tâi-lô or Pe̍h-ōe-jī, and adjust the dictionaries, shortcuts, the candidate window's look and its colours.

Keeping TaigiKeyboard running takes a lot. If it helps you, sponsorship is welcome: your support gives me the strength to keep working for Taiwanese.

Bîn-hiân
values.ja:
台語齒盤は、無料でオープンソースの台湾語入力ツールです。入力エンジンは台湾の人たち自身が開発しています。台語齒盤はずっと無料で、広告もなく、有料機能を出すこともありません。一般の利用者、学生、先生、学校、台湾語教育団体のどなたでも自由に使えます。台湾語を書くとき、教えるときに、余計な負担がないことを願っています。

台語齒盤ウェブ版は現在パソコンのみ対応しています。英語入力に切り替えれば、台湾語入力ソフトをインストールしなくても、すぐに台湾語を入力できます。

この文章を消せばすぐに使い始められます。タイトルも変更できます。左側に設定ページがあり、台羅・白話字のどちらでも入力でき、辞書の切り替え、ショートカット、候補ウィンドウの外観、色を調整できます。

台語齒盤の運営には多くの費用がかかります。お役に立てているなら、ご支援・ご寄付をお待ちしています。皆さまの支えが、台湾語のために頑張り続ける力になります。

Bîn-hiân

otherInputMethod.comment: Notice while another input method holds the keyboard.

values.hanji: 另外一个輸入法當咧用，關掉才會當佇遮拍字。
values.tailo: Līng-guā tsi̍t ê su-ji̍p-huat tng-teh iōng, kuainn--tiāu tsiah ē-tàng tī tsia phah-jī.
values.poj: Lēng-gōa chi̍t ê su-ji̍p-hoat tng-teh iōng, koaiⁿ--tiāu chiah ē-tàng tī chia phah-jī.
values.en: Another input method is active. Turn it off to type here.
values.ja: 別の入力方法が使用中です。オフにするとここに入力できます。

plainText.comment: Save button: download the text as a .txt file. Its siblings Markdown and HTML are names, not translated.

inspectorTitle.comment: Title of the segmentation and ranking inspector.

values.ja: 並べ替えエンジン実験室

inspectorSyllables.comment: Label of the syllable row in the inspector.

inspectorWords.comment: Label of the word-cut row in the inspector.

inspectorCandidates.comment: Heading of the comparison grid on the dev page.

inspectorEmpty.comment: Inspector while nothing is being composed.

values.hanji: 開始拍字了後，遮會顯示引擎按怎切詞、按怎排候選。
values.tailo: Khai-sí phah-jī liáu-āu, tsia ē hián-sī ian-jín án-tsuánn tshiat-sû, án-tsuánn pâi hāu-suán.
values.poj: Khai-sí phah-jī liáu-āu, chia ē hián-sī en-jín án-chóaⁿ chhiat-sû, án-chóaⁿ pâi hāu-soán.
values.en: Start typing. This shows how the engine cuts the input and orders the candidates.
values.ja: 入力を始めると、区切り方と候補の順がここに出ます。

inspectorNoCut.comment: Inspector when the buffer is not a whole syllable yet, so there is no word cut.

values.hanji: 這段猶未有完整的音節，所以猶未斷詞。下面若有，是打到一半的詞。
values.tailo: Tsit tuānn iáu-bē ū uân-tsíng ê im-chat, sóo-í iáu-bē tuànn-sû. Ē-bīn nā ū, sī phah kàu puànn-lōo ê sû.
values.poj: Chit toāⁿ iáu-bē ū oân-chéng ê im-chat, só͘-í iáu-bē toàn-sû. Ē-bīn nā ū, sī phah kàu pòaⁿ-lō͘ ê sû.
values.en: This is not a whole syllable yet, so nothing is cut into words. Rows below, if any, are words the typing is heading toward.
values.ja: まだ音節が揃っていないので、単語には切っていません。下に出るのは途中の語です。

inspectorCutWalker.comment: Caption when the word row is the walker's lowest-cost cover.

values.hanji: 頂面是音節，下面是引擎選的切法：規段成本上低的一條。你選過的多音節詞，或者你存過的詞，會予彼一段較袂閣被切開。
values.tailo: Tíng-bīn sī im-chat, ē-bīn sī ian-jín suán ê tshiat-huat: kui tuānn sêng-pún siōng-kē ê tsi̍t tiâu. Lí suán-kuè ê to-im-chat sû, hi̍k-tsiá lí tshûn-kuè ê sû, ē hōo hit tsi̍t tuānn khah bē koh pī tshiat-khui.
values.poj: Téng-bīn sī im-chat, ē-bīn sī en-jín soán ê chhiat-hoat: kui toāⁿ sêng-pún siōng-kē ê chi̍t tiâu. Lí soán-kòe ê to-im-chat sû, he̍k-chiá lí chhûn-kòe ê sû, ē hō͘ hit chi̍t toāⁿ khah bē koh pī chhiat-khui.
values.en: Syllables are on top. Under them is the cut the engine chose: the lowest-cost cover of the whole input. A multi-syllable word you have picked, or a word you saved, makes that stretch harder to split.
values.ja: 上は音節です。下はエンジンが選んだ区切りで、入力全体のコストが一番低い切り方です。選んだ多音節語や登録した語は、その区間が割れにくくなります。

inspectorCutSyllables.comment: Caption when no dictionary word covers the buffer, so the reading stays in syllables.

values.hanji: 辭典無詞通蓋這段，所以無併做一塊，改照音節來讀。
values.tailo: Sû-tián bô sû thang khàm tsit tuānn, sóo-í bô pīng chò tsi̍t tè, kái tsiàu im-chat lâi tha̍k.
values.poj: Sû-tián bô sû thang khàm chit toāⁿ, só͘-í bô pèng chò chi̍t tè, kái chiàu im-chat lâi tha̍k.
values.en: No dictionary word covers this, so the engine does not glue it into one piece. It reads the syllables.
values.ja: この区間を覆う辞書の語がないので、一つにはまとめず、音節のまま読みます。

inspectorRankOneWord.comment: Developer-page switch. A one-word best path joins the twelve sort stages.

values.ja: 一語の文も並べ替えに入れる

inspectorRankOneWordNote.comment: What the developer-page switch changes, and that the writing page leaves it off.

values.hanji: 打開了後，kip 這種一個詞的整句會進入十二關，不再固定排頭前。選詞權重排佇縮寫頭前的時，選過的縮寫就排會贏。多詞的整句照舊固定。書寫頁面無開這个。
values.tailo: Phah--khui liáu-āu, kip tsit khuán tsi̍t ê sû ê tsíng-kù ē tsìn-ji̍p tsa̍p-jī kuan, bô-koh kòo-tīng pâi thâu-tsîng. Suán-sû kuân-tāng pâi tī sok-siá thâu-tsîng ê sî, suán-kuè ê sok-siá tō pâi ē iâⁿ. To-sû ê tsíng-kù tsiàu-kū kòo-tīng. Su-siá ia̍h-bīn bô khui tsit ê.
values.poj: Phah--khui liáu-āu, kip chit khoán chi̍t ê sû ê chéng-kù ē chìn-ji̍p cha̍p-jī koan, bô-koh kò͘-tēng pâi thâu-chêng. Soán-sû koân-tāng pâi tī sok-siá thâu-chêng ê sî, soán-kòe ê sok-siá tō pâi ē iâⁿ. To-sû ê chéng-kù chiàu-kū kò͘-tēng. Su-siá ia̍h-bīn bô khui chit ê.
values.en: When this is on, a one-word path such as kip joins the twelve stages instead of staying at the front. A picked abbreviation can then lead, once selection weight is ordered ahead of abbreviation. A sentence of several words stays pinned. The writing page never turns this on.
values.ja: オンにすると、kip のような一語の文は先頭に固定されず、十二段階に入ります。選択の重みが略称より前なら、選んだ略称が上に来られます。複数語の文は固定のままです。執筆ページではオンになりません。

inspectorCustomNote.comment: The developer page writes the same custom dictionary the writing page reads.

values.hanji: 佇遮加入的詞，書寫頁面也會揣著。刪除學習紀錄袂清掉自訂詞。
values.tailo: Tī tsia ka-ji̍p ê sû, su-siá ia̍h-bīn iā ē tshuē--tio̍h. San-tî ha̍k-si̍p kì-lio̍k bē tshing-tiāu tsū-tīng-sû.
values.poj: Tī chia ka-ji̍p ê sû, su-siá ia̍h-bīn iā ē chhōe--tio̍h. San-tî ha̍k-si̍p kì-lio̍k bē chheng-tiāu chū-tēng-sû.
values.en: A word saved here is found on the writing page too. Delete Learning Records leaves custom words in place.
values.ja: ここで保存した語は執筆ページでも見つかります。学習記録を削除してもカスタム語は残ります。

inspectorFrontLead.comment: The checks that fill slot 0 before the twelve sort stages run.

values.hanji: 第 0 格佇這幾關就定矣，無參加下面十二關。拖順序無影響。頭一關無過，後壁的關就無比。
values.tailo: Tē 0 keh tī tsit kuí kuan tō tiānn--ah, bô tsham-ka ē-bīn tsa̍p-jī kuan. Thua sūn-sī bô íng-hióng. Thâu tsi̍t kuan bô kuè, āu-piah ê kuan tō bô pí.
values.poj: Tē 0 keh tī chit kúi koan tō tiāⁿ--ah, bô chham-ka ē-bīn cha̍p-jī koan. Thoa sūn-sī bô éng-hióng. Thâu chi̍t koan bô kè, āu-piah ê koan tō bô pí.
values.en: Slot 0 is decided in these checks, before the twelve stages. Reordering those stages does not move it. Once a check fails, the later checks are not compared.
values.ja: 0 枠はこの段階で決まり、下の十二段階には入りません。順番を入れ替えても動きません。一つの段階で落ちると、それより後は比べません。

inspectorFrontWords.comment: Front check: how many words the whole-buffer path was cut into.

inspectorFrontOneWord.comment: The whole-buffer path is a single word, so nothing can take slot 0.

inspectorFrontManyWords.comment: The whole-buffer path is several words, so a later check may replace it. {count} is the word count.

inspectorFrontKind.comment: Front check: the next row has to be a prefix longer than what was typed.

inspectorFrontSpan.comment: Front check: the next row has to cover the whole buffer.

values.tailo: Āu tsi̍t miâ tsia̍h ê huān-uî
values.poj: Āu chi̍t miâ chia̍h ê hoān-ûi
values.en: How much the next row covers

inspectorFrontSyllables.comment: Front check: the next row has to be at least two syllables.

inspectorFrontWeight.comment: Front check: the next row's selection weight has to be higher than the sentence.

inspectorFrontSyllableValue.comment: Syllable count of the row challenging slot 0. {count} is the number.

inspectorFrontHeldWords.comment: Slot 0 stays because the best path is one word. Later checks, including selection weight, are not compared.

values.hanji: 這段干焦一个詞，整句固定排頭前。後壁的條件無比，選詞權重無搖會換掉伊。
values.tailo: Tsit tuānn kan-ta tsi̍t ê sû, tsíng-kù kòo-tīng pâi thâu-tsîng. Āu-piah ê tiâu-kiānn bô pí, suán-sû kuân-tāng bô iô-uē uānn-tiāu i.
values.poj: Chit toāⁿ kan-ta chi̍t ê sû, chéng-kù kò͘-tēng pâi thâu-chêng. Āu-piah ê tiâu-kiāⁿ bô pí, soán-sû koân-tāng bô iô-ōe ōaⁿ-tiāu i.
values.en: This stretch is one word, so the sentence stays at the front. The later checks are not compared, and selection weight cannot replace it.
values.ja: この区間は一語なので、文全体は先頭のままです。後の条件は比べず、選択の重みでは入れ替わりません。

inspectorFrontHeldHere.comment: Slot 0 stays because row {index} failed the check named by {reason}. Later checks are not compared.

values.hanji: 第 {index} 名佇「{reason}」無符合，所以整句留佇頭前。後壁的關無比。
values.tailo: Tē {index} miâ tī "{reason}" bô hû-ha̍p, sóo-í tsíng-kù lâu tī thâu-tsîng. Āu-piah ê kuan bô pí.
values.poj: Tē {index} miâ tī "{reason}" bô hû-ha̍p, só͘-í chéng-kù lâu tī thâu-chêng. Āu-piah ê koan bô pí.
values.en: Row {index} fails “{reason}”, so the sentence stays at the front. The later checks are not compared.
values.ja: {index} 位は「{reason}」を満たさないので、文全体は先頭のままです。後の段階は比べません。

inspectorFrontTaken.comment: Every front check passed, so row {index} replaced the sentence at slot 0.

values.hanji: 第 {index} 名這幾關攏過，選詞權重嘛較大，所以換掉整句。
values.tailo: Tē {index} miâ tsit kuí kuan lóng kuè, suán-sû kuân-tāng mā khah tuā, sóo-í uānn-tiāu tsíng-kù.
values.poj: Tē {index} miâ chit kúi koan lóng kè, soán-sû koân-tāng mā khah tōa, só͘-í ōaⁿ-tiāu chéng-kù.
values.en: Row {index} passes every check, and its selection weight is higher, so it replaces the sentence.
values.ja: {index} 位はすべての段階を通り、選択の重みも大きいので、文全体と入れ替わります。

inspectorSentence.comment: Why the whole-sentence segmentation occupies the first candidate slot.

values.hanji: 這是整句的斷詞，固定先佔一格，無佮下面的詞比分數。
values.tailo: Tse sī tsíng-kù ê tuànn-sû, kòo-tīng sing tsiàm tsi̍t keh, bô kah ē-bīn ê sû pí hun-sòo.
values.poj: Che sī chéng-kù ê toàn-sû, kò͘-tēng seng chiàm chi̍t keh, bô kah ē-bīn ê sû pí hun-sò͘.
values.en: This is the whole-sentence cut. It takes a slot before the words are scored against each other.
values.ja: これは文全体の区切りです。下の語と点数を比べる前に、一つの枠を取ります。

inspectorSentenceAfter.comment: The sentence cut was moved down because a picked word outranks it.

values.hanji: 你選過的詞蓋過整句斷詞，所以整句被推落來。
values.tailo: Lí suán-kuè ê sû khàm-kuè tsíng-kù tuànn-sû, sóo-í tsíng-kù pī thui--lo̍h-lâi.
values.poj: Lí soán-kòe ê sû khàm-kòe chéng-kù toàn-sû, só͘-í chéng-kù pī thui--lo̍h-lâi.
values.en: A word you have picked outranks the sentence, so the sentence moves down.
values.ja: 選んだ語が文全体の区切りより上なので、区切りは下に下がります。

inspectorLiteral.comment: The row that is exactly the typed text, pinned at the front.

values.hanji: 這格是你拍的字本身，固定排頭前。
values.tailo: Tsit keh sī lí phah ê jī pún-sin, kòo-tīng pâi thâu-tsîng.
values.poj: Chit keh sī lí phah ê jī pún-sin, kò͘-tēng pâi thâu-chêng.
values.en: This row is exactly what you typed. It stays at the front.
values.ja: これは打った文字そのものです。いつも先頭に置きます。

inspectorLead.comment: The first row the sort itself chose, after any pinned rows.

values.hanji: 除去固定排頭前的，這是排序的第一名。
values.tailo: Tû-khì kòo-tīng pâi thâu-tsîng ê, tse sī pâi-sū ê tē-it miâ.
values.poj: Tû-khì kò͘-tēng pâi thâu-chêng ê, che sī pâi-sū ê tē-it miâ.
values.en: This is the first row the sort itself chose.
values.ja: 固定で先頭に置くものを除くと、並べ替えの一位はこれです。

inspectorPinnedAhead.comment: A row sits first even though row {index} sorts ahead of it at the stage named by {reason}.

values.hanji: 這筆固定排佇頭前。第 {index} 名佇{reason}較贏。
values.tailo: Tsit pit kòo-tīng pâi tī thâu-tsîng. Tē {index} miâ tī {reason} khah iâⁿ.
values.poj: Chit pit kò͘-tēng pâi tī thâu-chêng. Tē {index} miâ tī {reason} khah iâⁿ.
values.en: This row is pinned at the front. Row {index} sorts ahead at {reason}.
values.ja: この候補は先頭に固定されています。{index} 位が{reason}で上です。

inspectorPickedOver.comment: A picked word took the slot ahead of the sentence cut.

values.hanji: 你選過這个詞，而且伊蓋過整句斷詞，所以排頭前。
values.tailo: Lí suán-kuè tsit ê sû, jî-tshiánn i khàm-kuè tsíng-kù tuànn-sû, sóo-í pâi thâu-tsîng.
values.poj: Lí soán-kòe chit ê sû, jî-chhiáⁿ i khàm-kòe chéng-kù toàn-sû, só͘-í pâi thâu-chêng.
values.en: You have picked this word, and it outranks the sentence cut, so it leads.
values.ja: この語は選んだことがあり、文全体の区切りより上なので先頭です。

inspectorBeats.comment: Why this candidate is ahead of the previous one. {reason} is a clause.

values.en: Ahead of the row above, because {reason}.
values.ja: 一つ上より前なのは、{reason}からです。

inspectorReasonTier.comment: Sort reason: this row covers the whole input and the previous one covers only the front.

values.hanji: 伊食規段輸入，上一筆干焦食頭前
values.tailo: i tsia̍h kui tuānn su-ji̍p, tsi̍t-pí kan-na tsia̍h thâu-tsîng
values.poj: i chia̍h kui toāⁿ su-ji̍p, chi̍t-pí kan-na chia̍h thâu-chêng
values.en: it covers everything typed, and the row above covers only the front
values.ja: 入力全体を食べていて、一つ上は先頭だけ

inspectorReasonAbbreviation.comment: Sort reason: the previous row is an abbreviation.

values.en: the row above is an abbreviation

inspectorReasonPreference.comment: Sort reason: this row was picked, or it is a saved custom word.

values.hanji: 你選過伊，抑是伊是你存的詞
values.tailo: lí suán-kuè i, ia̍h-sī i sī lí tshûn ê sû
values.poj: lí soán-kòe i, ia̍h-sī i sī lí chhûn ê sû
values.en: you have picked it, or it is a word you saved
values.ja: 選んだことがあるか、登録した語

inspectorReasonCoverage.comment: Sort reason: a closer syllable match than the row above.

values.hanji: 伊比上一筆較接近完整的音節
values.tailo: i pí tsi̍t-pí khah tsiap-kīn uân-tsíng ê im-chat
values.poj: i pí chi̍t-pí khah chiap-kīn oân-chéng ê im-chat
values.en: it matches the syllables more closely than the row above
values.ja: 一つ上より音節の一致が近い

inspectorReasonUserWeight.comment: Sort reason: a higher decayed selection weight.

values.hanji: 你選伊的次數較濟，權重猶佇咧
values.tailo: lí suán i ê tshù-sòo khah tsē, khuân-tāng iáu tī--leh
values.poj: lí soán i ê chhù-sò͘ khah chē, koân-tāng iáu tī--leh
values.en: you have picked it more, and that weight is still there
values.ja: 選んだ回数が多く、その重みがまだ残っている

inspectorReasonContext.comment: Sort reason: it continues the previous word.

values.tailo: i tsiap tī tsi̍t ê sû āu-bīn
values.poj: i chiap tī chi̍t ê sû āu-bīn

inspectorReasonWalkerCost.comment: Sort reason: the corpus sees it more often.

values.en: the corpus sees it more often
values.ja: コーパスでよりよく出る

inspectorReasonScore.comment: Sort reason: a higher dictionary score.

inspectorReasonFrequency.comment: Sort reason: a higher dictionary frequency.

inspectorReasonCoverageBytes.comment: Sort reason: it consumes more of what was typed.

values.tailo: i tsia̍h ê jī khah tsē
values.poj: i chia̍h ê jī khah chē
values.en: it consumes more of what you typed
values.ja: 食べている文字が多い

inspectorReasonSource.comment: Sort reason: its dictionary source ranks higher.

inspectorReasonStable.comment: Sort reason: every other field ties.

inspectorPicks.comment: How many times the user has picked this word. {count} is a number.

inspectorPicksAgo.comment: Pick count plus how many days since the last pick. {count} and {days} are numbers.

values.hanji: 選過 {count} 次，約 {days} 日前

inspectorNever.comment: This word has never been picked.

inspectorWeight.comment: The decayed selection weight. {weight} is a number like 1.20.

inspectorCoversAll.comment: This candidate consumes the whole input.

inspectorCoversFront.comment: This candidate consumes only part of the input.

inspectorKindDictionary.comment: A word cut that came from the dictionary.

inspectorKindCustom.comment: A word cut that is a custom-dictionary entry.

inspectorKindReading.comment: A stretch the dictionary has no word for, read as syllables.

inspectorUserSpan.comment: A saved or learned word sits on this stretch, so the cut prefers to keep it whole.

values.hanji: 這段有你存過抑是學過的詞，斷詞會盡量莫閣切開
values.tailo: Tsit tuānn ū lí tshûn-kuè ia̍h-sī o̍h-kuè ê sû, tuànn-sû ē tsīn-liōng mài koh tshiat-khui
values.poj: Chit toāⁿ ū lí chhûn-kòe ia̍h-sī o̍h-kòe ê sû, toàn-sû ē chīn-liōng mài koh chhiat-khui
values.en: A word you saved or learned sits here, so the cut tries to keep this stretch whole
values.ja: 登録した語か学習した語がここにあるので、この区間はなるべく割らない

inspectorMore.comment: Button that draws the next candidates. {count} is how many the click reveals.

inspectorBack.comment: Link from the dev page back to the writing page.

inspectorInput.comment: Accessible name of the dev page's typing field.

values.hanji: 佇遮拍字，看引擎按怎決定
values.tailo: Tī tsia phah-jī, khuànn ian-jín án-tsuánn kuat-tīng
values.poj: Tī chia phah-jī, khoàⁿ en-jín án-chóaⁿ koat-tēng
values.en: Type here to see how the engine decides
values.ja: ここに打つと、エンジンの決め方が出ます

inspectorChoices.comment: Label of the candidate strip on the dev page.

inspectorRaw.comment: Label of the typed buffer on the dev page.

inspectorHint.comment: How to read the comparison cards. Each card is one candidate.

values.hanji: 每一張是一个候選。藍色是決勝的階段，橘色是輸的階段，灰色是頭前已經分出。
values.tailo: Muí tsi̍t tiunn sī tsi̍t ê hāu-suán. Nâ-sik sī kuat-sèng ê kai-tuānn, kiaⁿ-á-sik sī su ê kai-tuānn, phuê-sik sī thâu-tsîng í-king hun-tshut.
values.poj: Múi chi̍t tiuⁿ sī chi̍t ê hāu-soán. Nâ-sek sī koat-sèng ê kai-toāⁿ, kiⁿ-á-sek sī su ê kai-toāⁿ, phuê-sek sī thâu-chêng í-king hun-chhut.
values.en: Each card is a candidate. Blue is the deciding stage, orange is a loss, and grey comes after the decision.
values.ja: 各カードが候補です。青が決着の段階、橙が負けた段階、灰色はその前に決着した段階です。

inspectorMechanismTitle.comment: Heading of the sort-rule section on the dev page.

inspectorPresetOriginal.comment: Sort-rules choice that restores the engine's built-in order and turns off ranking a one-word sentence.

inspectorPresetProposal.comment: Sort-rules choice named by the person who proposed it. Preference, selection weight, and syllable match move ahead of abbreviation, and a one-word sentence joins the sort.

inspectorPresetTest.comment: Sort-rules choice selected once the user changes the stage order or the one-word switch.

inspectorSortNote.comment: The twelve stages on the developer page can be reordered. The official input method keeps its own order.

values.hanji: 拖曳一關，或者用上下鍵，候選會馬上照新的順序重排。只影響這個開發頁面，正式輸入法照舊。
values.tailo: Thua tsi̍t kuan, hi̍k-tsiá iōng siōng-hā kiàn, hāu-suán ē bē-kín tsiàu sin ê sūn-sī tîng-pâi. Kan íng-hióng tsit ê khai-huat ia̍h-bīn, tsìng-sik su-ji̍p-huat tsiàu-kū.
values.poj: Thua chi̍t koan, he̍k-chiá ēng siōng-hā kiàn, hāu-soán ē bē-kín chiàu sin ê sūn-sī têng-pâi. Kan éng-hióng chit ê khai-hoat ia̍h-bīn, chèng-sek su-ji̍p-hoat chiàu-kū.
values.en: Drag a stage, or use the arrow keys. The candidates re-sort immediately. This page only; the input method keeps its own order.
values.ja: 段階をドラッグするか、上下キーで動かすと、候補はすぐ並び直ります。この開発ページだけで、入力メソッド本体の順序は変わりません。

inspectorSortReset.comment: Restores the engine's built-in twelve-stage order on the developer page.

inspectorMechanismLead.comment: How the twelve sort stages decide a pair. Smaller wins except the four descending fields named in the sentence.

values.hanji: 由第 1 關比到第 12 關。兩筆頭一个無仝的關就是決勝，後壁的關無閣比。數字愈細的贏；選詞權重、辭典分數、辭典詞頻、食的長度是愈大愈贏。第 0 格佇頂面「十二關頭前」就定矣，無參加這十二關。
values.tailo: Uì tē 1 kuan pí kàu tē 12 kuan. Nn̄g pit thâu tsi̍t ê bô kâng ê kuan tō sī kuat-sèng, āu-piah ê kuan bô koh pí. Sòo-jī jú sè jú iâⁿ; suán-sû kuân-tāng, sû-tián hun-sòo, sû-tián sû-pîn, tsia̍h ê tn̂g-tōo sī jú tuā jú iâⁿ. Tē 0 keh tī tíng-bīn "tsa̍p-jī kuan thâu-tsîng" tō tiānn--ah, bô tsham-ka tsit tsa̍p-jī kuan.
values.poj: Ùi tē 1 koan pí kàu tē 12 koan. Nn̄g pit thâu chi̍t ê bô kâng ê koan tō sī koat-sèng, āu-piah ê koan bô koh pí. Sò͘-jī jú sè jú iâⁿ; soán-sû koân-tāng, sû-tián hun-sò͘, sû-tián sû-pîn, chia̍h ê tn̂g-tō͘ sī jú tōa jú iâⁿ. Tē 0 keh tī téng-bīn "cha̍p-jī koan thâu-chêng" tō tiāⁿ--ah, bô chham-ka chit cha̍p-jī koan.
values.en: The stages run from 1 to 12. The first stage where two rows differ is the decision, and the later stages are not compared. A smaller number wins, except selection weight, dictionary score, dictionary frequency, and bytes covered, where a larger number wins. Slot 0 is already decided in the section above these twelve stages.
values.ja: 第 1 段階から第 12 段階まで比べます。二つが最初に違う段階が決着で、それより後は比べません。数字が小さい方が勝ちます。選択の重み、辞書スコア、辞書の頻度、覆った長さは大きい方が勝ちます。0 枠は上の「十二の段階の前」で決まっていて、この十二段階には入りません。

inspectorDetailTier.comment: Stage 1: a span that reaches the end of the input leads a front segment.

values.hanji: 食到輸入尾的排頭前，干焦食頭前一段的排後壁。taiuanl 的「台灣人」會排佇「台灣」頭前。
values.tailo: Tsia̍h kàu su-ji̍p bué ê pâi thâu-tsîng, kan-ta tsia̍h thâu-tsîng tsi̍t tuānn ê pâi āu-piah. taiuanl ê "Tâi-uân-lâng" ē pâi tī "Tâi-uân" thâu-tsîng.
values.poj: Chia̍h kàu su-ji̍p bé ê pâi thâu-chêng, kan-ta chia̍h thâu-chêng chi̍t toāⁿ ê pâi āu-piah. taiuanl ê "Tâi-oân-lâng" ē pâi tī "Tâi-oân" thâu-chêng.
values.en: A row that reaches the end of what you typed comes first. A row that covers only a front stretch comes after. For taiuanl, 台灣人 comes before 台灣.
values.ja: 入力の末尾まで覆う候補が先です。先頭の一部だけを覆う候補は後です。taiuanl では「台灣人」が「台灣」より前に来ます。

inspectorDetailAbbreviation.comment: Stage 2: within a tier, a reading leads an abbreviation.

values.hanji: 仝一段內，照讀音拍的排佇縮寫頭前。縮寫是逐个音節的頭一个字母。
values.tailo: Kāng tsi̍t tuānn lāi, tiàu tha̍k-im phah ê pâi tī sok-siá thâu-tsîng. Sok-siá sī ta̍k ê im-tsiat ê thâu tsi̍t ê jī-bó.
values.poj: Kāng chi̍t toāⁿ lāi, tiàu tha̍k-im phah ê pâi tī sok-siá thâu-chêng. Sok-siá sī ta̍k ê im-chiat ê thâu chi̍t ê jī-bó.
values.en: Inside the same tier, a reading comes before an abbreviation. An abbreviation is the first letter of each syllable.
values.ja: 同じ段の中では、読みで打った候補が略称より前です。略称は各音節の最初の字です。

inspectorDetailPreference.comment: Stage 3: selected words, then never-selected custom words, then the rest.

values.hanji: 選過的詞排頭前，閣來是存過、猶未選的自訂詞，閣來是其他。
values.tailo: Suán-kuè ê sû pâi thâu-tsîng, koh-lâi sī tsûn-kuè, iáu-buē suán ê tsū-tīng sû, koh-lâi sī kî-thann.
values.poj: Soán-kòe ê sû pâi thâu-chêng, koh-lâi sī chûn-kòe, iáu-bōe soán ê chū-tēng sû, koh-lâi sī kî-thaⁿ.
values.en: Words you have picked come first, then custom words you saved and have not picked, then everything else.
values.ja: 選んだ語が先、次に保存してまだ選んでいないカスタム語、その次がその他です。

inspectorDetailCoverage.comment: Stage 4: full syllable, then prefix, then abbreviation.

values.hanji: 完整音節排頭前，閣來是拍一半的前綴，閣來是縮寫。
values.tailo: Uân-tsíng im-tsiat pâi thâu-tsîng, koh-lâi sī phah tsi̍t puànn ê tsiân-tzuì, koh-lâi sī sok-siá.
values.poj: Oân-chéng im-chiat pâi thâu-chêng, koh-lâi sī phah chi̍t pòaⁿ ê chiân-chuì, koh-lâi sī sok-siá.
values.en: A full syllable comes first, then a prefix of a longer reading, then an abbreviation.
values.ja: 完全な音節が先、次に読みの途中までの接頭、その次が略称です。

inspectorDetailUserWeight.comment: Stage 5: higher decayed selection weight wins.

values.hanji: 愈大愈頭前。選過的詞佇這關再分先後；無選過的權重是 0。
values.tailo: Jú tuā jú thâu-tsîng. Suán-kuè ê sû tī tsit kuan koh hun sian-āu; bô suán-kuè ê kuân-tāng sī 0.
values.poj: Jú tōa jú thâu-chêng. Soán-kòe ê sû tī chit koan koh hun sian-āu; bô soán-kòe ê koân-tāng sī 0.
values.en: A larger weight comes first. This is where picked words separate from each other. A word never picked has weight 0.
values.ja: 大きい方が先です。選んだ語どうしの順番はここで分かれます。一度も選んでいない語の重みは 0 です。

inspectorDetailContext.comment: Stage 6: a continuation of the previous word, learned before bundled.

values.hanji: 接前一詞的排頭前：你學過的、閣來是內建語料、閣來是無接。
values.tailo: Tsiap tsîng tsi̍t sû ê pâi thâu-tsîng: lí ha̍k-kuè ê, koh-lâi sī luē-kiàn gí-liāu, koh-lâi sī bô tsiap.
values.poj: Chiap chêng chi̍t sû ê pâi thâu-chêng: lí ha̍k-kòe ê, koh-lâi sī lōe-kiàn gí-liāu, koh-lâi sī bô chiap.
values.en: A word that continues the previous one comes first: one you learned, then one from the bundled corpus, then no continuation.
values.ja: 前の語に続く候補が先です。学習したもの、次に同梱コーパス、その次が続きでないものです。

inspectorDetailWalkerCost.comment: Stage 7: lower corpus cost wins. Unpriced sorts after every priced row.

values.hanji: 愈細愈頭前，語料愈常寫的愈頭前。無標價的排佇有標價的後壁。
values.tailo: Jú sè jú thâu-tsîng, gí-liāu jú tsiâng siá ê jú thâu-tsîng. Bô piau-kè ê pâi tī ū piau-kè ê āu-piah.
values.poj: Jú sè jú thâu-chêng, gí-liāu jú chiâng siá ê jú thâu-chêng. Bô piau-kè ê pâi tī ū piau-kè ê āu-piah.
values.en: A smaller cost comes first: the word the corpus writes more often. A row the corpus does not price comes after every priced row.
values.ja: 小さい方が先で、コーパスでよく書かれる語が先です。値段のない候補は、値段のある候補の後です。

inspectorDetailScore.comment: Stage 8: higher frequency times syllable bias times boost wins.

values.hanji: 詞頻乘音節偏向乘加成，愈大愈頭前。
values.tailo: Sû-pîn sîng im-tsiat phian-hiòng sîng ka-sîng, jú tuā jú thâu-tsîng.
values.poj: Sû-pîn sêng im-chiat phian-hiòng sêng ka-sêng, jú tōa jú thâu-chêng.
values.en: Frequency times a syllable bias times a boost. A larger score comes first.
values.ja: 頻度 × 音節の偏り × 加成です。大きい方が先です。

inspectorDetailFrequency.comment: Stage 9: higher raw dictionary frequency wins.

values.hanji: 辭典裡的原始詞頻，愈大愈頭前。分數平手才用著。
values.tailo: Sû-tián lāi ê guân-sú sû-pîn, jú tuā jú thâu-tsîng. Hun-sòo pênn-tshiú tsiah īng--tio̍h.
values.poj: Sû-tián lāi ê goân-sú sû-pîn, jú tōa jú thâu-chêng. Hun-sò͘ pêⁿ-chhiú chiah ēng--tio̍h.
values.en: The raw count in the dictionary. A larger count comes first. It is used when the scores tie.
values.ja: 辞書にある生の頻度です。大きい方が先です。スコアが同じときだけ使います。

inspectorDetailCoverageBytes.comment: Stage 10: more covered bytes win, only after score and frequency tie.

values.hanji: 這筆食的位元組愈長愈頭前。分數佮詞頻攏平手才用著。
values.tailo: Tsit pit tsia̍h ê ūi-guân-tsoo jú tn̂g jú thâu-tsîng. Hun-sòo kah sû-pîn lóng pênn-tshiú tsiah īng--tio̍h.
values.poj: Chit pit chia̍h ê ūi-goân-chó͘ jú tn̂g jú thâu-chêng. Hun-sò͘ kah sû-pîn lóng pêⁿ-chhiú chiah ēng--tio̍h.
values.en: More bytes of the input covered comes first. It is used only when the score and the frequency both tie.
values.ja: 覆ったバイトが長い方が先です。スコアと頻度がどちらも同じときだけ使います。

inspectorDetailSource.comment: Stage 11: source rank, smaller first. Order matches source_tier_rank.

values.hanji: 順位愈細愈頭前：自訂、教育部臺灣台語常用詞辭典、公視台語台台語新詞辭庫、教育部學科術語臺灣台語對譯、工藝中心臺灣台語工藝詞庫。其他辭典共一个順位。
values.tailo: Sūn-uī jú sè jú thâu-tsîng: tsū-tīng, Kàu-io̍k-pōo Tâi-uân Tâi-gí Siông-iōng-sû Sû-tián, Kong-sī Tâi-gí-tâi sin-sû, Kàu-io̍k-pōo ha̍k-kho su̍t-gí, Kang-gē tiong-sim kang-gē sû-khòo. Kî-thann sû-tián kāng tsi̍t ê sūn-uī.
values.poj: Sūn-ūi jú sè jú thâu-chêng: chū-tēng, Kàu-io̍k-pō͘ Tâi-oân Tâi-gí Siông-iōng-sû Sû-tián, Kong-sī Tâi-gí-tâi sin-sû, Kàu-io̍k-pō͘ ha̍k-kho su̍t-gí, Kang-gē tiong-sim kang-gē sû-khò͘. Kî-thaⁿ sû-tián kāng chi̍t ê sūn-ūi.
values.en: A smaller rank comes first: custom, MOE Dictionary of Common Taiwanese Words, PTS Taigi New-Word Lexicon, MOE Academic Subject Terminology (Taigi), NTCRI Taiwanese Craft Glossary. Every other dictionary shares one rank.
values.ja: 順位が小さい方が先です。カスタム、教育部 台湾語常用語辞典、公視台語台 台湾語新語辞書、教育部 学術用語 台湾語対訳、工芸センター 台湾語工芸用語辞書。それ以外の辞書は同じ順位です。

inspectorDetailStable.comment: Stage 12: the earlier insertion wins when every other field ties.

values.hanji: 頭前攏平手，就照查出來的順序，較早查著的贏。
values.tailo: Thâu-tsîng lóng pênn-tshiú, tō tiàu tshiau--tshut-lâi ê sūn-sū, khah tsá tshiau-tio̍h ê iâⁿ.
values.poj: Thâu-chêng lóng pêⁿ-chhiú, tō tiàu chhiau--chhut-lâi ê sūn-sū, khah chá chhiau-tio̍h ê iâⁿ.
values.en: When every earlier stage ties, the row found first wins.
values.ja: ここまで全部同じなら、先に見つかった候補が勝ちます。

inspectorPinnedHeading.comment: Heading for candidate rows that do not enter the sort.

inspectorNoScored.comment: Shown when every visible row sits outside the sort.

values.hanji: 這幾格無參排序，所以無比較階段。
values.tailo: Tsit kuí keh bô tsham pâi-sū, sóo-í bô pí-kàu kai-tuānn.
values.poj: Chit kúi keh bô chham pâi-sū, só͘-í bô pí-kàu kai-toāⁿ.
values.en: These rows sit outside the sort, so no stage compares them.
values.ja: これらは並べ替えに入らないので、比較の段階はありません。

inspectorLostTo.comment: The candidate at {index} won at the stage named by {reason}.

values.tailo: Tē {index} miâ tī {reason} iâⁿ-kuè tsit pit.
values.poj: Tē {index} miâ tī {reason} iâⁿ-kòe chit pit.
values.ja: {index} 位が{reason}でこちらに勝っています。

inspectorBeatsRow.comment: This candidate beat the row at {index}. {reason} is the deciding stage name.

inspectorStageTier.comment: Sort stage: whole input before a front segment.

inspectorStageAbbreviation.comment: Sort stage: a reading before an abbreviation.

inspectorStagePreference.comment: Sort stage: picked words, then saved words, then the rest.

inspectorStageCoverageKind.comment: Sort stage: full syllable, then prefix, then abbreviation.

inspectorStageContext.comment: Sort stage: continuation of the previous word.

inspectorStageCoverageBytes.comment: Sort stage: how much of the input the row consumes.

inspectorStageStable.comment: Sort stage: insertion order, after every other field ties.

inspectorTierWhole.comment: Stage value: the row reaches the end of the input.

inspectorTierFront.comment: Stage value: the row covers only a front segment.

inspectorReading.comment: Stage value: the row is a reading, not an abbreviation.

inspectorAbbreviation.comment: Stage value: the row was reached as an abbreviation.

inspectorPrefPicked.comment: Stage value: the user has picked this word.

inspectorPrefCustom.comment: Stage value: a saved word the user has not picked.

inspectorPrefRest.comment: Stage value: neither a pick nor a saved word.

inspectorCovFull.comment: Stage value: the typed span is the word's whole reading.

inspectorCovPrefix.comment: Stage value: the typed span is a prefix of the word's reading.

inspectorContextLearned.comment: Stage value: a continuation the user has learned.

inspectorContextBundled.comment: Stage value: a continuation from the bundled corpus.

inspectorContextNone.comment: Stage value: the row does not continue the previous word.

inspectorUnpriced.comment: Stage value: the corpus does not price this row.

inspectorSourceOther.comment: Source rank when no priority dictionary bit is set.

inspectorNoSource.comment: The row has no dictionary record.

inspectorSources.comment: Heading of a candidate's dictionary sources.

inspectorDecided.comment: Mark on the comparison cell that decided this column.

inspectorTie.comment: Legend: this stage tied with the column on the left.

inspectorLater.comment: Legend: an earlier stage already decided, so this one was not compared.

inspectorRank.comment: The source-rank number the sort used. {rank} is a number.

inspectorPosition.comment: A candidate's place in the list. {index} is a number.

inspectorLegendWin.comment: Legend swatch: the stage that decided the pair.

inspectorLegendLose.comment: Legend swatch: this candidate lost at this stage.

inspectorLegendSkip.comment: Legend swatch: an earlier stage already decided.

inspectorLegendBase.comment: Legend swatch: the first row of the sort, the baseline.

inspectorPageUp.comment: Button that shows the previous page of candidates on the dev page.

inspectorPageDown.comment: Button that shows the next page of candidates on the dev page.
